# afs-mapping/

## Endpoints
- `GET|PUT|DELETE /api/accounting/afs-mapping/accounts` — list/map/unmap GL→AFS line (`?unmapped=true` returns unmapped only)
- `POST /api/accounting/afs-mapping/auto-map` — run heuristic auto-mapper on unmapped accounts
- `POST /api/accounting/afs-mapping/bulk` — bulk map `{ mappings: [{ glAccountId, afsLineCode }] }`
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/afs-mapping/lines` — list statement lines (`?section=balance_sheet|income_statement`); POST seeds default taxonomy
- `GET /api/accounting/afs-mapping/stats` — mapping coverage stats
- `GET /api/accounting/afs-mapping/trial-balance` — TB reorganised by AFS line codes (`?fiscal_period_id=` required, `?prior_period_id=` optional)

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))` on all routes.

## Request / Response
- `accounts` PUT body: `{ glAccountId, afsLineCode }`; DELETE body: `{ glAccountId }`
- `bulk` body: `{ mappings: Array<{ glAccountId, afsLineCode }> }` — both fields required per entry
- `lines` GET query `?section` restricted to `balance_sheet|income_statement`
- `trial-balance` response: `{ fiscalPeriodId, priorPeriodId, balanceSheet[], incomeStatement[] }`

## Business rules
- `fiscal_period_id` is mandatory on trial-balance
- Bulk validates each entry has both `glAccountId` and `afsLineCode` before dispatch
- Auto-map returns `{ mapped: number }` for heuristic-matched rows

## Related files
- `src/modules/accounting/services/afs/afsMappingService.ts` — all logic (mappings, taxonomy seed, auto-map, TB join)
